title: UCI Online Retail
citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
derivation: Positive, non-cancelled transactions with a customer identifier are aggregated by customer and calendar month. The partially observed final month is excluded. Activo means a purchase in the month, latente means one month without a purchase, and inactivo means two or more months without a purchase.
pedagogical_use: Private, restricted classroom use. The activity forecasts state transitions and does not choose retention interventions.
